sources.source_purpose: Primary machine-readable benchmark comparison across all 6 evaluated retrieval methods
Canonical JSON benchmark artifact containing dataset fingerprint, parameters, statistical tests, and regression reduction
Hostile audit reconciling Gate 11 vs historical runs, verifying ground-truth integrity and safety metric separation
metric_names_used: Test reduction verification (84.37% raw CSV vs 82.29% canonical macro-metric)

sources.source_purpose: Final release verification documenting 26 gate files, architecture freeze, and 220 automated tests passing
Actual measured runtime performance across the 12 live Round 2 demonstrator scenarios

discrepancies_and_notes.explanation: Documented in METRIC_INTEGRITY_AUDIT.md: historical 0.4805 run used a broken kwarg in index.search() resulting in 0 semantic contribution. Gate 11/14 fixed the API, yielding canonical 0.6311. Historical numbers are superseded.

discrepancies_and_notes.topic: Benchmark Latency vs Live Demonstrator Latency (0.79 ms vs 5.34 ms)
discrepancies_and_notes.explanation: Benchmark 0.79 ms measures in-memory vectorized retrieval. Demonstrator 5.34 ms includes cold disk I/O, string parsing, and test suite mapping. Both are distinct, valid, and explicitly labeled.

discrepancies_and_notes.topic: Safety Invariant (100%) vs Safety Discovery Recall (47.61%)
discrepancies_and_notes.explanation: Safety invariant T_safe SUBSET_OF T_selected is 100% enforced by the non-bypassable safety gate. The 47.61% figure measures unassisted upstream discovery by the retrieval engine alone before safety gate enforcement. These must never be conflated.
